name: Ankaros Sector
description: Frontier sector of the Ultima Segmentum under heavy military, diplomatic, and theocratic tension.

systems.name: Ankaros
systems.description: Primary federal system, home to the planetary administrative seat and Altus orbital station.

systems.name: Aethelgard
systems.description: High-tech stronghold under exclusive control of the Elion Technocracy.

systems.name: Void-G3
systems.description: Former Elion industrial powerhouse devastated by the Atronics machine uprising.

systems.name: Arunia
systems.description: Martial and feudal coalition uniting Sfergrad knights and fierce Yuma warrior clans.

systems.name: Serenis
systems.description: System of extreme contrasts between the tropical luxury retreats of Eden and the glacial fanaticism of the Angelus Cult.

systems.name: Arakna
systems.description: Biomechanical planetary nightmare, pulsating heart of the Great Infestation contested by the Coalition.

systems.name: Suro
systems.description: Major diplomatic and trade hub housing the ecumenopolis Neotori Prime and the SAFE federal fleet.

systems.name: Olk
systems.description: Radioactive and toxic purgatory ruled by the decadent Black Barons of Olkeris.

systems.name: Nebula
systems.description: Sanctuary of polite ultra-capitalism where Gentech and the Saurian Consortium wage silent corporate warfare.

systems.name: Alpha-7
systems.description: Clandestine political capital and headquarters of Karam Poulpard's Free Worlds Alliance.

systems.name: Grak's Belt
systems.description: Anarchic haven for outlaws, Gruk salvagers, and exiled Drak warriors.

systems.name: Nexus
systems.description: Dead Zone housing the cyclopean Ancient Eleri Nexus, coveted by every galactic faction.
